title: Chapter 2660 - 73: Bone Engraving Array_2
content:
Chapter 2660: Chapter 73: Bone Engraving Array_2

"Iron Skill Bone..." Mo Hua nodded, "I ask you, where did you send the other members of the Danque Tribe?"

Iron Skill Bone’s face changed, clearly having his secret exposed by Mo Hua.

But his mouth remained stubborn, "I don’t know what you’re talking about..."

Mo Hua stared at Iron Skill Bone, his gaze indifferent, but he was deep in thought.

Finding survivors of the Danque Tribe isn’t that hard.

But the problem is, next, I need to "catch" an Evil God.

An Evil God isn’t easy to catch, otherwise, it wouldn’t be called an Evil God.

Thus, a "bait" is needed...

Mo Hua’s gaze shifted, suddenly narrowing slightly, revealing a hint of danger.

Iron Skill Bone, for some reason, was trembling all over from Mo Hua’s gaze, even his bones were shaking.

"What... do you want to do?"

Mo Hua turned his head and said, "Lord Chi Feng."

Chi Feng was silent for a moment, then nodded, "Mr. Witch..."

Along the journey, Mo Hua’s show of orientation, planning, eloquence, aura, skills, and his ability to foresee and suppress Elder Ba Shan’s evil thoughts gave Barbarian General Chi Feng a bit more recognition of Mo Hua.

Although he might not think Mo Hua is truly a shaman, he knew this "young man" who gained the Young Master’s approval was definitely not ordinary.

A capable person naturally deserves respect.

Therefore, he also addressed Mo Hua as "Mr. Witch" in words.

Mo Hua then continued, "Lord Chi Feng, break Iron Skill Bone’s legs again, better yet, make sure the bones are exposed."

Iron Skill Bone looked terrified.

He had no idea what this malicious young man, with such venomous actions, meant by it.

To break already broken legs again? And expose the bones?

Iron Skill Bone was filled with resentment, inwardly cursing Mo Hua as a natural "bad seed"!

Chi Feng hesitated for a moment but didn’t spare his effort.

The Shugubu attacked the Danque Tribe, massacring the people, they deserved to die.

Wars between tribes are cruel by nature, and this Shugubu leader named "Iron Skill Bone" was not worth pitying. Just breaking his bones was a mercy to him.

Chi Feng, a large figure, lifted his leg high, completely breaking Iron Skill Bone’s two thigh bones again.

The cracked leg bones even protruded through the flesh.

Mo Hua, seeing his bones, was very satisfied.

Iron Skill Bone endured unbearable pain, cursing Mo Hua from start to finish in his heart, but with blood at the corners of his mouth, he couldn’t utter a word.

Mo Hua continued to ask Iron Skill Bone, "The question I asked you earlier, will you answer it?"

Iron Skill Bone was about to speak, but the pain was so overwhelming that he couldn’t open his mouth.

Mo Hua nodded, "Very well, Iron Skill Bone, your bones are iron, and your mouth is equally hard. It seems without making you suffer a bit, you won’t talk."

Mo Hua thought for a moment, then asked Chi Feng to drag Iron Skill Bone into a small cave.

Mo Hua took out some formation tools and placed them on the ground, making Iron Skill Bone kneel on them.

Iron Skill Bone was in such pain that he lost even the will to curse Mo Hua.

Mo Hua then, with a serious expression, said to Dan Zhu and Chi Feng:

"Let’s split up our tasks, you go outside to track Shugubu’s whereabouts and interrogate the other captives. I’ll handle the interrogation of Iron Skill Bone."

Dan Zhu glanced at Mo Hua, who was torturing Iron Skill Bone without batting an eye, feeling that this Mr. Witch seemed somewhat unfamiliar.

The impression of the "gentleman" he had, with a face of compassion, a heart of goodwill, advocating for tribal equality, felt quite different.

A thought of compassion, a thought of cruelty.

Dan Zhu felt somewhat conflicted.

Chi Feng didn’t say much, he only said, "Then I’ll leave it to Mr. Witch."

Dan Zhu thought for a moment, then said, "Sir, please... be careful..."

Mo Hua waved his hand, "Don’t worry."

After Dan Zhu and Chi Feng left, Iron Skill Bone was tormented by the punishment board, feeling like he was in hell, and with the concealment of the small cave, it was the perfect time as no one else could notice.

Mo Hua looked at Iron Skill Bone’s exposed thighbone, stealthily took out a bottle of ink.

He then silently recalled in his heart the Great Wilderness Bone Carving Skill he learned from "Mr. Tu" in the Desolate Heaven Blood Sacrifice Formation.

Combining the "Wood White Gold Jade" Bone Casting Method he acquired through secret means from the Bai Family by the Taixu Sect Master.

Then, using Divine Sense Control Ink, unbeknownst to everyone, using Iron Skill Bone as a "guinea pig", he attempted to draw some formations on his fractured leg bones from afar.

Unbeknownst to Iron Skill Bone, the red spiritual ink turned into thin threads, winding through the air, finally climbing onto Iron Skill Bone’s leg bones like fine, long snakes.

As soon as the first formation pattern was "carved" onto the bone.

Almost simultaneously, a shrill scream, akin to "slaughtering a pig", echoed, shaking the entire forest.

Iron Skill Bone’s facial features twisted, emitting a sound of pain beyond words.

Even Mo Hua was taken aback, his ears buzzing from the shock.

Then Iron Skill Bone simply passed out from the pain.

Mo Hua was dumbfounded.

The next moment, Dan Zhu and Chi Feng rushed over, asking:

"Sir, what happened..."

Then they saw Iron Skill Bone, painted with white bone war makeup and usually grim as tough meat, now his facial features distorted, foaming at the mouth, unconscious on the ground.

Mo Hua composed himself and waved his hand, "It’s nothing, I just applied the punishment a little too heavily..."

Dan Zhu looked at Iron Skill Bone, then at Mo Hua, shocked in his heart, finding it hard to imagine just how heavy the "little too heavily" punishment was, enough to make a Golden Core scream like a pig being slaughtered, with death unknown.

Barbarian General Chi Feng’s eyelid couldn’t help but twitch.

"Then..."
